name: DeadLetterQueue / Supervisor::dead_letter

test_list.description: Letters come out oldest first while the queue is not full.
Pushing past capacity evicts the oldest letter, returns it to the caller and increments the drop counter; length never exceeds capacity.
drain() returns all letters in order, leaves the queue empty and keeps the cumulative drop counter.
For any capacity and push count: len <= capacity and len + dropped == pushed.
Supervisor::dead_letter stores the letter and publishes DeadLettered { message }.
When the supervisor's bounded DLQ overflows, the snapshot reports dlq_len == capacity and dlq_dropped == overflow count.

inputs.name: letter
inputs.description: Item, child name, exit class and attempts.

output_description: The evicted oldest letter when the queue was full, otherwise None.
